messages:
marta (PM): Quick sync — want to scope a small, focused beta for the Dedicated/Dedicated+Private feature set. target cohort: 8-10 teams, 6 weeks active testing. goal: validate routing policies + KV cache behavior in real apps, and confirm cost/latency impact before we open to more customers.

aj (Eng): +1. We should be explicit about what we consider 'done' for beta. My list: stable serving on their reserved pools, observed KV cache hit > 20% for typical conv workloads, no P0 regressions for 2 consecutive weeks.

samir (Solutions): Recruiting note — lean on AEs + CSMs for well-scoped customers. Prefer prod apps with predictable traffic (chatbots, search rerank). We should also ask for a technical contact and an SLO owner.

lia (CS): I can run outreach to 12 candidates and bucket them by readiness. Suggest incentives: 3 months free Dedicated credits, quarterly advisory call, and priority onboarding. Also propose a simple screening form.

beth (Design): For feedback loops, weekly 30m sync + shared Miro board for usability notes. Also capture prompt sets and a short eval harness so we can measure quality regression per model variant.

marta (PM): Draft screening form (quick):
```
1) Company name and size
2) Primary workload (chat / search / embeddings / other)
3) Monthly request volume (est)
4) Must-have features to test (routing, KV cache, quantized weights, autoscale)
5) Technical contact + Slack handle
6) Willingness to run a 6-week integration + weekly check-ins (Y/N)
```

aj (Eng): Nice. Add: do you run any prefix caching today? if yes, please share hit rate. That helps us set baseline.

samir (Solutions): Success metrics proposal:
- Integration time <= 3 weeks to first traffic
- Observed 10-30% cost reduction per token after tuning (or better)
- Latency p95 within our target for that workload
- Qualitative: partner rates experience >= 7/10 at exit survey

lia (CS): Also track operational signals: number of support escalations, onboarding blockers, and feature requests during beta. Use those to decide scope changes.

marta (PM): Proposed launch criteria to graduate from beta: all active partners onboarded and meeting primary SLOs (latency/cost), no outstanding P0s, runbook and rollback tested, and at least two partners report production-ready confidence.

beth (Design): For scope negotiation: lock in a small subset for beta: routing policies, KV caching, model pinning, and rollout control (canary). Defer: autoscaling UI, multi-tenant billing, and advanced optimizer suggestions — leave for GA.

aj (Eng): We'll need a short telemetry spec for partners: what events we need, how to share logs (s3 link or syslog), and sample queries to compute cache hit and token cost. I'll post a stub in #eng-runtime after this thread.

lia (CS): Communication cadence idea: week 0 onboarding + tech workshop; weeks 1-5 weekly syncs; week 6 exit survey + findings doc. Ops-bot: please auto-create a recurring calendar for participants once we confirm cohort.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Dedicated Beta Weekly Sync" starting 2026-05-05, recurring weekly for 6 weeks. Guests: marta, aj, samir, lia, beth. :white_check_mark:

marta (PM): Risks: we might need to cut scope if partners take longer to integrate. Proposal: allow rolling admission — start with 3 really ready partners, then add 2-3 every 2 weeks.

samir (Solutions): Agree. For recruiting, I recommend prioritizing customers who already use our hosted API and have obvious latency/cost pain. We get faster wins.

beth (Design): I'll prepare a lightweight feedback template (NPS, top 3 friction points, and one wishlist item). Keep it 5 minutes to maximize responses.

aj (Eng): Technical guardrails: automatic fallback to hosted model variants if Dedicated pool is unhealthy; circuit-breaker thresholds; and a hotfix path. We should make these explicit in the onboarding doc.

marta (PM): OK next steps: lia to send recruiting list by EOD Thu; samir + aj to produce telemetry + integration checklist by next Tue; beth to share feedback template by Mon; I'll pull together final scope doc and invite recruiting candidates.

lia (CS): On it. I'll tag candidates in the doc and flag top 8.

samir (Solutions): I'll include recommended test prompts and a tiny eval harness (runnable as a GH gist).

marta (PM): Thanks all — aiming to kick off first cohort first week of May. If anyone has objections to timeline, speak now. :thumbsup: for approval

aj (Eng): :thumbsup:

beth (Design): :thumbsup:

lia (CS): :thumbsup:

samir (Solutions): :thumbsup:

marta (PM): Closing — I'll post the recruiting doc link in #product after I tidy it up.
